It is completely understandable to feel unsure or concerned when you notice a coworker behaving this way. While talking to oneself or laughing randomly can sometimes be a sign of someone experiencing hallucinations or losing touch with reality, there are many other common explanations. He might be wearing a discreet Bluetooth earpiece, thinking out loud, replaying a funny memory, or simply managing stress and focus in his own way. 

Unless his behavior is disruptive, he seems distressed, or you feel unsafe, it is usually best to give him the benefit of the doubt and respect his space. However, if you are genuinely worried about his well-being or if his actions begin to impact the workplace, you might consider privately sharing your observations with a manager or HR representative. They are equipped to check in on him professionally and ensure he has support if he happens to need it.
